name: airbrake_projects
description: Airbrake projects: list, get, list_activities (audit log). Project updates are intentionally NOT modeled here — the /api/v4/projects/:id update endpoint requires dashboard-session credentials, not Personal API tokens, and returns 401 for all tokens our MCP supports. Use the Airbrake dashboard to change project settings. Returns the raw Airbrake JSON payload — no data is removed.
